verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਘਾਉ ਘਾਇਲ ਕੋ ਜਤਨ ਕੈ ਨੀਕੋ ਹੋਤ ਪਰਿ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਇ ਲੀਕ ਮਿਟਤ ਨ ਪੇਖੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise ghaau ghail ko jatan kai neeko hot par miT jai leek miTat na pekheeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as the wound gets cured with medicine and the pain also vanishes, but the scar of the wound is never seen to vanish.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਫਾਟੋ ਅੰਬਰੋ ਸੀਆਇ ਪੁਨਿ ਓਢੀਅਤ ਨਾਗੋ ਤਉ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਤਊ ਥੇਗਰੀ ਪਰੇਖੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise faaTo a(n)baro seeaai pun oddeeat naago tau na hoi tuoo thegaree parekheeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as a torn cloth stitched and worn does not bare the body but the seam of the stitch is visible and conspicuous.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਟੂਟੈ ਬਾਸਨੁ ਸਵਾਰ ਦੇਤ ਹੈ ਠਠੇਰੋ ਗਿਰਤ ਨ ਪਾਨੀ ਪੈ ਗਠੀਲੋ ਭੇਖ ਭੇਖੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise TooTai baasan savaar dhet hai ThaThero girat na paanee pai gaTheelo bhekh bhekheeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as a broken utensil is repaired by coppersmith and even the water does not leak from it, but it is repaired form stays.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਿ ਬਿਮੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਦੇਖਿ ਪੁਨਿ ਸਰਨ ਗਹੈ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਪੈ ਕਲੰਕ ਲੇਖ ਲੇਖੀਐ ॥੪੧੯॥
verses.translit_en: taise gur charan bimukh dhukh dhekh pun saran gahai puneet pai kala(n)k lekh lekheeaai ||419||

en.bdb: Similarly, a disciple who has turned away from the holy feet of the True Guru comes back to the Guru's refuge when he feels the pain of his actions. Although he is freed of his sins and becomes pious, yet the .blemish of his apostasy remains.  (419)
